QuestInfo.name: Return of the Dark Lord
QuestInfo.parent: The One Hidden in the Shadow
QuestInfo.0: #b#p2081400##k says he has something to tell me...perhaps I should pay him a visit.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p2081400##k told me to meet #b#p1052001##k. Now that I think about it, it's been a long time since I've seen the Dark Lord. He never seems to age...
QuestInfo.2: #p1052001# said he has some interesting suggestions and that if I'm interested, he'll tell me more.

0.0: You have the 4th Job advancement. Do you still have things to do? If not, I'd like to suggest something you may find interesting.

yes.0: Wise choice. I thought you would accept my suggestion. Don't worry, this will be helpful for you too.
yes.1: Do you know #b#p1052001##k? I thought you would know him as he made you a Thief. Go to see him. He might need you.

no.0: If you do not try something you're not familiar with, you are not a true Thief.

1.0: Since you are here, you must be a Thief. You look familiar... You came here when you were a beginner, didn't you? Wow, look at you.You became a wonderful Thief. Are you the one #p2081400# sent?

yes.0: That's right. I saw something special in your eyes. I have a suggestion for you. Come back to me if you are interested.
